messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Severity: high — GPU pool 'eu-west-1-pool-a' above 95% utilization for 6m, queue length=1,240, tail latency 99p=4.8s. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions; hit tenant quota. Alert ID: #INC-4112345678

ravi (oncall-sre): ack. I'm on it. starting triage — dashboards + recent deploys

lucas (serving): noticed v28 rollout started ~18:12 UTC for 30% traffic. Metrics show average context length jumped from ~1.2k -> ~7.5k for v28. kv-cache miss rate spiked.

anya (ml-eng): confirming — v28 changed tokenizer and added aggressive prefill for system prompts. It increases initial KV writes and long-lived KV entries per request. Could blow up KV footprint and prefill IO.

ravi (oncall-sre): can you post model config or the rollout gate id?

anya (ml-eng): rollout tag: model-v28-rollout/2026-03-15T18:10. config snippet:
```
prefill.enabled: true
prefill.mode: eager
prefill.max_tokens: 2048
kv.cache.ttl: 12h
```

lucas (serving): logs: many long-lived sessions holding KV entries. Sample trace from frontend: 
```
[2026-03-15T18:21:03Z] req_id=abc123 pool=eu-west-1-pool-a queued=612ms state=running ctx_tokens=8421 kv_entries=173
```

chris (sre): autoscaler error seen in controller logs: `scale up failed: quota exceeded for project-redwood-eu (hard limit 24 GPUs)`. We've already at 24 reserved, burst disabled.

sam (infra): cloud ticket open with provider but cannot promise fast add. provisioning queue is long.

hazel (support): support dashboard shows increase in 500s for customers A, C (both dedicated) starting 18:22 UTC. SLA error rate +2.4%. Customers are pinging CSMs.

ravi (oncall-sre): action list: 1) pause v28 rollout 2) route new traffic to v27 3) disable prefill globally (or per-route) 4) evict stale KV entries if safe 5) attempt manual scale with emergency quota request

lucas (serving): executing canary pause now. `./deploy rollback --tag model-v28-rollout --action pause`

deploy-bot: rollback requested by lucas at 2026-03-15T18:25:10Z — pause applied to 100% of canary targets.

anya (ml-eng): pushing recommendation: instead of full rollback, flip prefill.enabled=false for v28 since inference quality drop is minor for initial tests. If we disable prefill the KV writes should reduce dramatically.

ravi (oncall-sre): lucas, can you gate that config change via serving flags?

lucas (serving): applying flag `model.v28.prefill=false` via runtime config. Pushing to 30% shard targets now.

lucas (serving): flag applied. metrics show per-request KV entries dropping in new instances — good signal.

ravi (oncall-sre): traffic reroute to v27 in progress: `route-manager set-weight model-v27 0.85 model-v28 0.15` then will set v28->0 if safe.

deploy-bot: route change executed: v27=0.85, v28=0.15 at 18:29:42Z

maya (prod-eng): queue length dropped from 1,240 -> 420 in last 3m. GPU util 95% -> 78%. Keep monitoring for 10m.

hazel (support): noting customers A and C see partial recovery in 5xxs. Messaging: "We've applied mitigations and are continuing to monitor; will follow up in 30m."

chris (sre): still seeing some long tail requests locked with ctx_tokens >6k. evict script could free a lot: `scripts/evict_old_kv --pool eu-west-1-pool-a --age 4h` — risk: might drop some active sessions if TTL heuristics wrong.

anya (ml-eng): recommend targeted eviction for sessions flagged idle >30m, not global. I can produce list of session IDs with last_activity < 30m.

ravi (oncall-sre): agree targeted only. anja? (typo) — anya, pls provide IDs.

anya (ml-eng): pasting list (trimmed): s-78a, s-78b, s-79f ... pushing to SRE channel.

ravi (oncall-sre): chris, go ahead with `evict_old_kv --sessions-file /tmp/idle_sessions.txt` once I get the file.

chris (sre): running eviction now. Expect transient 404 for evicted sessions.

chris (sre): eviction complete. reclaimed ~220GB KV, queue dropped to 210, GPU util 62%.

sam (infra): provider escalated quota request; they say capacity can be increased but 45-60m ETA. we'll keep the request open for safety but not required immediately.

lucas (serving): full reroute to v27 executed: `route-manager set-weight model-v27 1.0 model-v28 0.0` at 18:42:10Z. v28 now paused.

hazel (support): updating customers: "We paused a recent model change that increased resource usage; we reclaimed capacity and are monitoring. Please reach out if you see issues."

ravi (oncall-sre): summary for handoff: mitigations done — paused v28, disabled prefill flag on v28, routed traffic to v27, targeted KV eviction completed, queue & GPU util recovered. No manual infra scale required after eviction.

ravi (oncall-sre): incident severity: high during window 18:20-18:40 UTC. customer impact: transient 5xx increase on dedicated customers A and C, some request timeouts for public API ~0.8% of traffic at peak.

maya (prod-eng): I'm taking on-call for next shift. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and coordinate postmortem.

ravi (oncall-sre): handing off to maya — full context in thread. tagging incident postmortem owner. :white_check_mark:

maya (prod-eng): ack — I'll open the incident ticket, assign to anya+lucas+chris for RCA on v28 prefill change and autoscaler hard quota check. Will include customer impact timeline and next steps (preventative controls: rollout size gating, simulated KV footprint test, autoscaler soft-guard to throttle rollout earlier).

hazel (support): notes for postmortem: customers A/C notified, support cases #INC-A123, #INC-C456 opened. Expect follow-up comms after RCA.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-4112345678 status -> mitigated (active alerts cleared). Postmortem ticket created: PM-4112345678.

maya (prod-eng): final note: leave v28 paused until ML and Serving have an agreed reduced-prefill config + load test. Closing thread for on-call, will reopen if regression.
